_comment: Primary sources every rate claim in this repository traces to. Verify with: python -m harness.verify_primary
provenance: Retrieved from the taxo.online mirror. The official CBIC portal (taxinformation.cbic.gov.in) serves an incomplete TLS certificate chain, so it could not be fetched over a verified connection, and bypassing verification for documents whose integrity is the point would be self-defeating. The copies are pinned by SHA-256 and their content is asserted below; see rate_schedule.md for what remains open.
